title: Object-oriented C# — one screen
rememberThis: C# has one base class. Extra capabilities come from interfaces or composition — the pattern you already use in microservices.
virtual and override use the real dispatch table. new hides a member but does not override it. sealed stops further override.
record (class) uses value equality and with-expressions. Auth tokens and Redis DTOs belong here. Dictionary keys need GetHashCode that matches Equals.
bullets: Prefer injecting collaborators over deep domain hierarchies in workers and API hosts.
Default Interface Methods (DIM, C# 8) evolve contracts without breaking implementers; explicit implementation hides members from the class surface.
record struct is a value type with value equality; record class is a reference type with value equality.
TypeScript private is compile-time only. Common Language Runtime (CLR) private is metadata the runtime enforces.
